# stopcock

> Fast, composable TypeScript packages for functional programming, dates, async work, HTTP, state, diffing, linear algebra, automatic differentiation, signal processing, color, SVG, and image processing.

Packages are independently installable under the `@stopcock` scope.

## Install

```bash
bun add @stopcock/fp
```

## Guides

- [Cookbook](https://stopcock.dev/cookbook/): Practical @stopcock/fp 2.0 recipes
- [Getting Started](https://stopcock.dev/getting-started/): Install stopcock and build your first pipe with fusion, Option, and Result
- [Playground](https://stopcock.dev/playground/): Interactive REPL to try stopcock pipes, fusion, and modules in the browser

## Concepts

- [Inspect pipelines with explain()](https://stopcock.dev/concepts/explain/): Read Stopcock's static pipeline plan, boundaries, executors, and pure rewrites
- [Fusion](https://stopcock.dev/concepts/fusion/): How pipe fuses array operations
- [Option and Result](https://stopcock.dev/concepts/option-result/): Explicit absence and recoverable failure

## Libraries

- [async](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/async/): Lazy Task type with concurrency, retry, and cancellation
- [autodiff](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/autodiff/): Reverse-mode automatic differentiation for scalar, vector, and matrix values
- [color](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/color/): Color as a first-class value — 11 spaces, perceptual ops, WCAG contrast, CVD simulation
- [date](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/date/): Zero-allocation functional date utilities with branded types
- [diff](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/diff/): Structural diffing, patching, composition, and rebasing for objects and arrays
- [eslint-plugin-fp](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/eslint-plugin-fp/): ESLint flat-config rules for Stopcock FP 2
- [fp-codemod](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/fp-codemod/): Conservative TypeScript-aware FP 1 to FP 2 migrations
- [fp-compiler](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/fp-compiler/): Optional build-time lowering for portable FP pipelines
- [fp-interop](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/fp-interop/): Explicit boundaries between Stopcock FP and foreign values
- [fp-testing](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/fp-testing/): Deterministic law checks, edge cases, and iterator probes
- [fp](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/fp/): Portable, typed functional programming for TypeScript
- [http](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/http/): Typed HTTP client with retry, timeout, dedup, and Task integration
- [img](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/img/): Image processing, filters, convolution, transforms
- [la](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/la/): Typed-array vectors, matrices, decompositions, and optional acceleration hooks
- [parser](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/parser/): Typed parser combinators with precise source errors
- [pattern](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/pattern/): Exhaustive structural pattern matching for TypeScript
- [persistent](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/persistent/): Immutable collections with structural sharing and explicit builders
- [signal](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/signal/): Deterministic DSP kernels over typed arrays
- [state](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/state/): Reactive state management with structural diffs, fine-grained subscriptions, and undo/redo
- [Stream migration](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/stream/): Stream was replaced by the Iter module in @stopcock/fp 2.0
- [svg](https://stopcock.dev/libraries/svg/): Pipe-native procedural SVG with typed nodes, defs hoisting, filters, and linear-algebra helpers

## API

- [Algebra and ordering](https://stopcock.dev/api/algebra/): Eq, Hash, Ord, Semigroup, Monoid, Group, and Ordering
- [A (Array)](https://stopcock.dev/api/array/): Filter, map, sort, group, and 30+ array functions for pipe
- [B (Boolean)](https://stopcock.dev/api/boolean/): not, and, or, ifElse. Boolean combinators for pipe
- [Dict migration](https://stopcock.dev/api/dict/): Dict was replaced by Record in @stopcock/fp 2.0
- [G (Guards)](https://stopcock.dev/api/guards/): isString, isNumber, isNil, isDeepEqual and more. Runtime type guards with TypeScript predicates
- [Iter](https://stopcock.dev/api/iter/): Lazy synchronous sequences with correct iterator closing
- [Lens migration](https://stopcock.dev/api/lenses/): The 2.0 optic module replaces the old root lens helpers
- [Logic migration](https://stopcock.dev/api/logic/): Logic was split into focused function and guard modules
- [M (Math)](https://stopcock.dev/api/math/): add, multiply, sum, mean, median. Arithmetic and stats for pipe
- [Module catalogue](https://stopcock.dev/api/modules/): Every public @stopcock/fp 2.0 entrypoint
- [N (Number)](https://stopcock.dev/api/number/): clamp, sum, mean, percentile. Numeric transforms for pipe
- [Object](https://stopcock.dev/api/object/): Safe immutable object, merge, and typed path operations
- [Optic](https://stopcock.dev/api/optic/): Composable immutable focus with lenses, prisms, traversals, and more
- [O (Option)](https://stopcock.dev/api/option/): Some and None for missing values. map, flatMap, filter, getOrElse, toResult
- [R (Result)](https://stopcock.dev/api/result/): Fail-fast recoverable errors, refinement, traversal, and optional decoding
- [Schema interop](https://stopcock.dev/api/schema/): Standard Schema V1 adapters without a second validation framework
- [S (String)](https://stopcock.dev/api/string/): trim, split, replace, startsWith, slice. String transforms for pipe
- [V (Validation)](https://stopcock.dev/api/validation/): Accumulate independent validation errors while staying compatible with Result

## Showcases

- [Color](https://stopcock.dev/showcases/color/): Interactive demo of stopcock/color — color spaces, palettes, mixing, contrast, gamut mapping, and CVD simulation
- [Image Processing](https://stopcock.dev/showcases/img/): Interactive demo of stopcock/img filters and transforms
- [SVG + Color Batch](https://stopcock.dev/showcases/svg-color-batch/): Whole-image CVD simulation feeding a procedural SVG pattern and badge overlay
